main_text.l: יִתְעַבַּד Fiat, Esr.6.11: תִּתְעַבְּדוּן Efficiemini, D.in.2.7.
עָבָד m. Servus: plur. עֲבָדִים Servi. Chald. עֲבָדֵיהֶם Facta, Opera eorum, Eccles.9.1.
עַבַד m. Chald. Servus, Dan.6.20: עַבְדּוֹהִי Servi ipsius, לַעֲבָדֵיךְ Servis tuis, לַעַבְדּוֹהִי Servos, Dan 3.28.
עֲבָדָה f. Servitus, Ministerium, Opus, Cultus.
עֲבִידַת בֵּית אֱלָהָא f. Chal. Opus: const. עבידת Opus Domus Dei, Esr.4.24.
מַעֲבָדִים m. p. Facta. Chald. מַעַבְדוֹהִי Facta eorum, Dan.4.34.
עָבַח Denfum, Crassum, Incrassatum, Obesatum esse.
עָבִי עָב m. Denfitas, Denfum: Trabs.
עַבְטִיט m. Denfum lutum, vox composita ex עָב & טִיט. Periphrasis divitiarum.
עָבַט Pigneratus est, Pignora accipit, Mutuatus est dato pignore. Pihel עִבַּט Pervertere, quasi idem cum עוּת. Hiphil הֶעֱבִיט Mutuavit sub pignore.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking forms were transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Hebrew vowel points are doubtful and may contain errors. The page is a dictionary page with Hebrew headwords and Latin glosses.
